Buyer guide

Pallet Truck vs. Pallet Stacker

Use a pallet truck to move loads horizontally and a stacker when the task includes lifting into storage positions.

Browse products

Pallet truck

Use a pallet truck for horizontal movement and low fork lift only.

Pallet stacker

Use a stacker when the pallet must be placed into racking or raised for positioning.

Selection checkpoint

If lifting height is above floor-transfer level, specify a stacker and verify residual capacity.
